summary: Current classifications (Catalogue of Life, 2,193,940 accepted species; NCBI Taxonomy) and a synthetic molecular tree (Open Tree of Life, 2,385,875 tips) are open via APIs. None of the searches surfaced a machine-readable pre-molecular classification, so the circularity the assessors raise remains unresolved.
next_step: Find or transcribe a historical classification (e.g. a 19th-century systematic work) mapped to modern names, then compare it with the Open Tree synthetic tree for shared taxa.
obstacles_confirmed: Modern classifications already incorporate phylogenetic data.
No machine-readable historical classification found in these searches.
